findings.quoted_text: Work Product created in the course of the project is the property of Client throughout. Contractor will transfer the Work Product to Client upon completion of the project, once Client has met all of its commercial obligations under this Agreement.
Invoices are payable Net 30. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 1.0% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law.

Work Product created in the course of the project is the property of Client throughout. Contractor will transfer the Work Product to Client upon completion of the project, once Client has met all of its commercial obligations under this Agreement.
findings.explanation: Stating that the Work Product is the client's property 'throughout' implies immediate ownership vesting upon creation before final payment or project completion, which can be problematic if payment disputes arise.
findings.suggested_change: Modify the clause so that Contractor retains all right, title, and interest in the Work Product until full payment of all fees is received, at which point ownership transfers to Client.

findings.quoted_text: Invoices are payable Net 30. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 1.0% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law.
findings.explanation: Net 30 payment terms require waiting a full month after invoicing to receive funds, which can strain freelancer cash flow.
findings.suggested_change: Change the payment terms from Net 30 to Net 15 to ensure faster cash flow.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a great day. I have reviewed the contract and would like to request a small update to the agreement before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, stating that the Work Product is the client property throughout implies immediate ownership vesting upon creation before final payment, which can be problematic. We propose to modify the agreement so that the contractor retains all right, title, and interest in the Work Product until full payment of all fees is received, at which point ownership transfers to the client. Thank you for your time and understanding. Best regards
